description: npm dependencies inherit a 3-day release-age quarantine from config:best-practices. pnpm-workspace.yaml separately enforces a 2-day floor at install time, so a Renovate pull request is never younger than CI will accept.

packageRules.description: typescript-eslint 8.x declares peer typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, so 6.1.x would already break it. Raise this bound when typescript-eslint widens that range; TypeScript 7's native package drops the compiler API it needs entirely.
Batch routine dev-dependency updates into a single pull request.

customManagers.description: Tool images are pinned in a shell case statement, which no built-in manager reads.
